subject.title: Add rate limiting and throttling for external API calls

question: Should this tracker define a core outbound policy layer for provider dispatch first, or a broader cross-API rate-limit/budget system that also covers tools and channel/plugin calls?
rationale: The remaining work changes config schema, provider dispatch semantics, possible persistent state, CLI/status UX, and plugin/channel ownership boundaries; source inspection can show the gap but cannot choose the permanent product/API scope.

options.title: Provider Dispatch First
options.body: Land or replace the focused provider request limiter, then keep separate maintainer-scoped follow-ups for budgets, CLI/status, tools, and channel/plugin APIs.

options.title: Design Full Core Policy
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers specify one core policy model for providers, tools, channels, budgets, queueing, and observability together.

options.title: Plugin/API Boundary First
options.body: Keep core lean by designing generic plugin/provider hooks for external packages to enforce rate and budget policy before adding core-owned behavior.

recommendation.title: Provider Dispatch First
recommendation.body: Land or replace the focused provider request limiter, then keep separate maintainer-scoped follow-ups for budgets, CLI/status, tools, and channel/plugin APIs.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans core config, provider transport, and product boundary policy where steipete has the strongest recent history and maintainer-context signal.
